title: MetaMask wallet in Edge
whyItMatters: The extension stores the encrypted vault with the wallet seed and every key it manages, plus a record of accounts and networks. With the password the funds are gone.
source: MetaMask extension id ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm from its Microsoft Edge Add-ons listing: https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/metamask/ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm
notes: Only applies when MetaMask was installed from the Edge Add-ons store. If it was installed in Edge from the Chrome Web Store it keeps the Chrome id, so check wallet.metamask.chrome too.
